cause.title: Cause

warning.description: The backend's dominant warning, where errors ended the pass.
warning.title: Warning

PassStop.title: PassStop

PauseCause.description: What paused a run, beside the stop reason that says how the cycle was left.
PauseCause.title: PauseCause

PrefixReading.description: A provider's prefix-cache discount as every surface reads it, served whole.

badge.description: `c39%` / `c0%` / `c?`, and empty on a replay, whose line already carries 📖.
badge.title: Badge

PrefixReading.title: PrefixReading

PricedKeyRecord.description: A key the search has PRICED, so a later read of it, resumed or not, prices nothing again.
PricedKeyRecord.title: PricedKeyRecord

Principal.description: Who issued an act: the id an audit joins on, and the name a surface shows for it.
Principal.title: Principal

ProjectionEnvelope.description: One outbound SSE frame, whose receiver treats an unknown field as a drift signal.

activity.description: The run's current state as of this frame — what it is doing and what still holds. Whole on every frame, so a client renders the newest one and folds nothing.

cycle_id.description: Target cycle the frame describes; redundant with the channel address but stamped per-frame for fan-in demux.
cycle_id.title: Cycle Id

kind.description: Closed-set discriminator; every CycleRecord record_type, plus stream_snapshot.
kind.title: Kind

payload.description: Per-kind body. For record-derived kinds, the record's model_dump; for stream_snapshot, the cycle's served dashboard.
payload.title: Payload

sequence.description: Ledger offset at append. Live-tail frames carry the record's offset; the leading stream_snapshot frame carries the offset captured at subscribe time.
sequence.title: Sequence

ProjectionEnvelope.title: ProjectionEnvelope

Proposal.description: What a proposer hands the round: an individual, its sparse overlay, and why it is refused.
Proposal.title: Proposal

ProviderEasedRecord.description: The provider answers the sender again: told at once to every ledger that heard the hold.
ProviderEasedRecord.title: ProviderEasedRecord

ProviderHoldRecord.description: A 429 episode's open or strike, heard by a ledger from its own sends.
ProviderHoldRecord.title: ProviderHoldRecord

RaceCatchUpRecord.description: The catch-up walks one just-measured cell of ``arm`` took: no pass records their cells.
RaceCatchUpRecord.title: RaceCatchUpRecord

RaceStandingRecord.description: Archive-only, not divergence-gated; ``p_best`` is about the arm ``current`` alone.
RaceStandingRecord.title: RaceStandingRecord

ReadingState.description: Whether a pair was read, and the ONE reason it was not.
ReadingState.title: ReadingState

ResolvedRunRecord.description: What a run init resolved, read over the chain: the declaration LAST wins, the roster FIRST.
ResolvedRunRecord.title: ResolvedRunRecord

RoleScope.description: Which roles a reading of an individual's cells may see; two scopes never pair.
RoleScope.title: RoleScope

RoundAdvance.description: Whether a closed round ADVANCED the best-so-far line.
RoundAdvance.title: RoundAdvance

RoundCells.description: A :class:`RoundResult`'s rows as archive addresses, in walk order.
RoundCells.title: RoundCells

RoundClosedRecord.description: The last close per round stands and IS the round.
RoundClosedRecord.title: RoundClosedRecord

RoundCompleteView.description: ``select:exit``; the readout HOLDS it until the round closes: the panel gate can unwind it.
RoundCompleteView.title: RoundCompleteView

RoundDiagnostics.description: One round's post-scoring diagnostics, computed once and read by every renderer.
RoundDiagnostics.title: RoundDiagnostics

RoundEnteredRecord.description: Entering N displaces N and every later round; ``rewound`` discards their proposals too.
RoundEnteredRecord.title: RoundEnteredRecord

RoundOutput.description: What ONE round produced, banked on that round; a round whose writer did not run holds ``cls()``, or nothing where it is written first.
RoundOutput.title: RoundOutput

RoundProposedRecord.description:
Banked by the bench once per round; replayed on a resume unless a digest the round ``consumed`` has moved.

``submitted`` is the operator's answer at the arm gate: the arms the round measures.
RoundProposedRecord.title: RoundProposedRecord

RoundStartView.description: ``propose:enter``; ``standing`` and ``note`` are the optimizer's own words (``RoundOpening``).
RoundStartView.title: RoundStartView

RoundWarningRecord.description: A mid-round SELF-HEAL the run continued past; never re-add a kind with no emitter.
RoundWarningRecord.title: RoundWarningRecord

RulerScope.description:
What one δ scale spans: one scorer's cells on ONE dataset. Arms link a scale only through
cells they share, and two datasets share none, so a δ is never compared across datasets.
RulerScope.title: RulerScope

RulerStamp.description:
The δ scale a reading was taken on: the tenant ruler at ``version`` less the rows of
``excluded``, the judged individuals it held. A cold stamp's ``id`` is flat.
RulerStamp.title: RulerStamp

RunLimits.description:
The budget a launch declared, beside its optimizer's own bounds; a served dashboard lays
the standing budget over it.
RunLimits.title: RunLimits

RunPhase.description:
The one run-state vocabulary every surface reads.

- ``queued``: a launch claimed the cycle and waits for a machine slot.
- ``starting``: a claimed launch past the queue, its process coming up.
- ``running``: a process is attached and driving the cycle.
- ``paused``: the worker exited and the cycle stays active and resumable.
- ``gate``: holding for the operator, at the round-0 origin gate or for a round's arms.
- ``detached``: active with no process holding its lock; derived at the read, never stored.
- ``terminal``: the cycle finished, and its stop reason says why.
RunPhase.title: RunPhase

RunPhaseRecord.description: The runner's own declaration: every other phase is derived off the last one, never said.
RunPhaseRecord.title: RunPhaseRecord

RunSpendView.description: The caps bound the CAMPAIGN, so they pair with its metered spend; this cycle's sits beside.
RunSpendView.title: RunSpendView

RunStanding.description: Where the run stands after a round: its selection, over whom, and how it reads against C0.

advanced.description: Of those, how many closed `advanced`: their pick separated from C0 on the origin panel — the verdict clock. Never summed with `improved`.
advanced.title: Advanced

improved.description: Of those, how many PROMOTED an arm. A bare point estimate (lift > 0, no interval), so it is the promotion clock and never a result; read `advanced`.
improved.title: Improved

lives.description: `stalls_left` of `stalls_left_cap`, read: the pips and their words, as the readout prints them. Null where the campaign banks no lives.

parent.description: The pick `selection` was promoted over. Null while it is the origin.

rounds_closed.description: Rounds closed AFTER the origin — the unit a rounds cap counts.
rounds_closed.title: Rounds Closed

selection.description: The optimizer's declared pick (`declared_selection`), as the arm it was first measured as: the origin until a round selects. Null before round 0 closes.

selection_line.description: The ONE text reading of the selection: who, and both rates on the origin panel — or the reason there is no pair. Never the selection's rate alone. The readout, `log.md`, the activity feed and every screen print this. Stamped by the two constructors alone.
selection_line.title: Selection Line

vs_origin.description: `selection` (`b`) over C0 (`a`) on the origin panel — the newest overlap reading of that pair. The state says why where there is none: `same_individual` while the selection is the origin.

RunStanding.title: RunStanding

RunWiringRecord.description: LAST wins, over the whole chain: a fork stands on its parent's until its own lands.
RunWiringRecord.title: RunWiringRecord

RuntimeFailure.description: One candidate's degradation evidence from its evaluation, beside a score that stands.

changes_description.description: What the originating candidate changed; informational, not a join key.
changes_description.title: Changes Description

degraded_count.description: Sample count with at least one warning.
degraded_count.title: Degraded Count

degraded_rate.description: Fraction of scored samples that emitted any pipeline warning.
degraded_rate.title: Degraded Rate

dominant_warning.description: ``{node_name}:{warning_type}`` of the most frequent warning across the candidate's measurements; the prefix selects the node whose config is captured in ``observed_config``.
dominant_warning.title: Dominant Warning

first_seen_round.description: Round number that first recorded this failure (dedup key component).
first_seen_round.title: First Seen Round

node.description: The node whose config ``observed_config`` captures: the ``dominant_warning`` prefix. ``None`` on a ``scoring_error_abort``, which names an error, not a node, and captures the whole config.
node.title: Node

observed_config.description: Snapshot of the failing node's effective config — the (param, value) tuples the `l1_config_not_in_runtime_failures` validator scans on subsequent rounds to reject re-proposals.
observed_config.title: Observed Config

owner.description: Who heals this runtime failure. Defaults to ``L1`` (a rate-based degradation L1 retunes the node config around); a deterministic-for-config break whose only fix is a locked surface (schema/model) is stamped ``OPERATOR`` so it escalates instead of churning in-loop.

source.description: Failure family: ``degradation`` (mid-eval DegradationCheck fired on warning-rate) or ``scoring_error_abort`` (scoring raised mid-eval and the candidate was retired).
source.title: Source

total_scored.description: Sample count actually measured for the candidate.
total_scored.title: Total Scored

RuntimeFailure.title: RuntimeFailure

ScoreSummary.description: An arm's fold of its cells: what it walked, and its level on them.
ScoreSummary.title: ScoreSummary

ScoringLockedRecord.description: Appended once, as the origin is scored under dials; a config already locked appends none.
ScoringLockedRecord.title: ScoringLockedRecord

SpawnedBy.description: The outer work-item an L4 inner cycle was spawned to measure.

individual_id.description: The outer individual's `OptSearchPoint.id` — stable across rounds, and the outer ARM's key where `role` is an arm's. Null outside a measured pass.
individual_id.title: Individual Id

role.description: WHY this cell ran (`MeasurementRole`). A backfill is spawned outside the round's shared order to fill a paired comparison, and reading one as the individual's own panel cell makes a repaired round unreproducible. Null outside a measured pass.
role.title: Role

round.description: Outer round; 0 is the origin (C0). Null when the spawn came from outside any round (the noise-floor diagnostic).
round.title: Round

task.description: The panel cell this run measured — the outer query, e.g. `justlogic/d234/seed-0` (`dataset.yaml::panel.tasks[].id`). The individual does NOT identify a run: every task runs for every individual, so one individual's spawns are as many as the panel has cells and are told apart only by this.
task.title: Task

SpawnedBy.title: SpawnedBy

SpawnedRecord.description: Appended at every open, so the last names the work-item the cycle last measured for.
SpawnedRecord.title: SpawnedRecord

SpendHoldRecord.description: Written BEFORE the send, at its bound; unclosed, it binds every ceiling and is not spent.
SpendHoldRecord.title: SpendHoldRecord

SpendTombstoneRecord.description: On the WORKSPACE ledger, so deleting what spent it cannot re-earn a spend ceiling.
SpendTombstoneRecord.title: SpendTombstoneRecord

StandingBudgetRecord.description: A cycle's standing budget, LAST wins; read PHYSICALLY, so a fork never inherits one.
StandingBudgetRecord.title: StandingBudgetRecord

StateSlice.description: State a member carries ACROSS rounds; a round's close banks it.
StateSlice.title: StateSlice

StopReason.description: Why a cycle's run ended or paused.
StopReason.title: StopReason

TestFamily.description: The set of tests one multiple-comparison correction was taken across.
TestFamily.title: TestFamily

ThetaCaveat.description:
A state in which θ is NOT ability; every number still renders, so WHICH fired is the fact.
Each is read off the cells a θ was read on: one level's, one arm's, a whole series'.
ThetaCaveat.title: ThetaCaveat

TokenAccount.description:
What ONE metered thing consumed: a provider round-trip, a measured row or a searchpoint.

``reasoning`` is a subset of ``output`` and both cache counts of ``input``, never further
totals. A null ``cache_read`` means no breakdown was reported; ``0`` means one was, with no hit.
TokenAccount.title: TokenAccount

TokenUsageRecord.description: ONE answered send, or a replay (``cached``); a send that reported no usage writes none.
TokenUsageRecord.title: TokenUsageRecord

TrailTombstoneRecord.description: On the WORKSPACE ledger, so deleting what was commanded cannot delete that it was.
TrailTombstoneRecord.title: TrailTombstoneRecord

Treatment.description: Two runs are one treatment only where ``digest`` agrees; no measurement key reads it.
Treatment.title: Treatment

ValidationFailure.description: An L1 output that broke a parse-time invariant, scoring its candidate a synthetic zero.

allowed.description: The accept-set the validator checked against. Empty list when the failure is mode-based (parse error, forbidden axis) rather than membership-based.
allowed.title: Allowed

axis.description: The parameter path that failed, ``{node_name}.{param}`` (e.g. ``llm_only.model``), or an axis on the generator's own output rather than a pipeline param: ``l1_generate.output`` (parse/shape failures) or ``variant`` (no-op / duplicate mutations).
axis.title: Axis

reason.description: Reason code that steers L2's healing direction. One of: ``forbidden_axis`` (operator-locked param touched), ``type_mismatch`` (wrong declared type), ``not_in_available_models`` / ``not_in_param_allowed_values`` / ``not_accepted_by_model`` (value outside the axis's resolved space — the last where the node declared it and the chosen model refuses it, so the healing move is the model, not the value), ``reproposes_known_failing_config`` (matches a prior ``RuntimeFailure.observed_config`` row), ``l1_provider_empty_response`` / ``optimizer_prompt_parse_failure`` / ``optimizer_prompt_unexpected_type`` (generator-side failure), ``steers_inner_stopping`` (an L4 override telling the inner loop when to STOP rather than how to search — it edits the frame `mean_bench_lift` averages over instead of the search it measures), ``steers_across_seeds`` (an L4 override making an inner node reason over the seed panel, which exists only one level up — the rule renders empty where it lands), ``guts_inherited_contract`` (an L4 override replacing a long prompt field with a fraction of its length, deleting contracts the parent carried in plain prose), ``no_op_variant`` / ``duplicate_variant`` (invariant-detect), ``hallucinated_node`` (named a node absent from the schema — NON-fatal: the phantom edit is stripped, the candidate still scores; routed as signal, not a synthetic-0).
reason.title: Reason

value.description: The offending value as rendered for the prompt; truncated to ≤300 chars for raw LLM output. Always a string — original type is encoded into the rendering when relevant.
value.title: Value

ValidationFailure.title: ValidationFailure

Variation.description: One variation node's act: which node ran, whether it asked a model, and the loci it wrote.

loci.description: The loci it left different from what it was handed, as `node.key`: the first one's against the first parent, a later one's against the variation before it.
loci.title: Loci

mode.description: `deterministic`: a function of its inputs and the run's seed. `llm`: a model's reply. `operator`: a person's own edit, submitted at the arm gate.
mode.title: Mode

node.description: `{manifest}:{node}` of the variation node that ran; `operator` where a person wrote it.
node.title: Node

Variation.title: Variation

VerifyGradedView.description: The pass is the fact, the reading a cache of one grading of it.
VerifyGradedView.title: VerifyGradedView

VerifyPass.description: The facts a verify pass banked, never a grade of them.
VerifyPass.title: VerifyPass

VerifyReading.description: A verify pass under a named scorer: the candidate on fresh cells, beside its decided ones.

accuracy_increment.description: `fresh` minus `recorded`, hit rate. Unpaired — the two are different cells.
accuracy_increment.title: Accuracy Increment

fresh.description: The level on the fresh cells alone, with its band.

held.description: Whether the fresh cells leave the recorded hit rate standing: its level sits at or below the fresh band's upper bound. `None` exactly where `held_absent` says why.
held.title: Held

held_absent.description: Why the fresh cells make no held / dropped call: `hard_picks` sit below the level whatever the candidate is worth, and `under_two_fresh` cells have no band. Read `vs_origin` there.
held_absent.title: Held Absent

recorded.description: The level on every cell a round's decision read this candidate on — its own walk and each re-score as a parent — re-read under this scorer: the number the fresh cells are a check on.

scorer_id.description: The grader every number here was read under. A stored copy is a cache of that reading: a reader under another grader reads the pass again, never this.
scorer_id.title: Scorer Id

strategy.description: How the fresh cells were picked: `random` from the unmeasured search split, or `hard` — its highest-δ cells first, which read BELOW the level by construction.
strategy.title: Strategy

vs_origin.description: This candidate over the campaign origin, on every cell the cycle measured both on outside the bench — the fresh ones and the overlap pass's included. `same_individual` on the origin itself.

VerifyReading.title: VerifyReading

WalkEnd.description: Why one walk ended before its last cell while its round went on.
WalkEnd.title: WalkEnd

WallClock.description: CLOCK legs sum to ``elapsed_s``; ``worked_s`` is CALL time, so concurrency pushes it past.
WallClock.title: WallClock

info.description:
GENERATED — do not edit. Regenerate with `python scripts/build_specs.py`.

The outbound Server-Sent Events channel: every frame is a `ProjectionEnvelope`, and a
record-derived frame's `payload` is the `CycleRecord` its `kind` names. The
subscription contract (snapshot first, then the live tail; gap recovery; no replay)
is `docs/developer/event-stream.md`.
info.title: Cycle event stream
